title: Identities
intro: Link GitLab users and commit addresses to Jira people. Proposals match by e-mail; only confirmed decisions attribute code activity.

state.unseenHint: No data source on this GitLab instance still has this identity.

confirmAllBody: Link every proposed identity to its matching Jira person and mark the proposed bots — {{count}} decisions. Each can be changed or removed later.
confirmAllFilterHint: Clear the search to confirm all proposals.
removeBody: Remove the decision for {{name}}? The identity goes back to proposed or unmapped.
removeFailed: The decision could not be removed

error.notFound: The identity or its decision no longer exists. Reload the list.
error.invalid: The request was rejected. Check the Jira person and try again.
error.conflict: This data source is not a GitLab source.
error.sourceGone: The data source no longer exists.
error.failed: Action failed. Check your connection and try again.

modal.title: Link to a Jira person
modal.hint: The whole site directory; type to search.

empty.PROPOSED: No proposals — every matching address is decided.

loadFailed: The identities could not be loaded
notFound: This data source does not exist or is not a GitLab source.
